metric: Per cell: contract flags + runs_episode + failure_class + dead_rate; consumer_completed_units; ratio_vs_practical_baseline (vs entity_planner+proportional on the SAME fork/join target); producer_policy_mode (learned_gates|planner_gates) and producer_tie_rel_tol recorded per row.
